subject: 360 Warranty
author: ZombieTron
body: My Premium 360 died with 3 red lights at the end of May and as M$ wanted £80 from me to get it fixed as I was out of warranty and it would mean sending my 360 away for a month I decided to buy a pre-owned core system. The core system I bought had 3 red lights after a couple of weeks so I exchanged it for another one. Today as the warranties have been extended I contacted M$ to pick up my dead system for FREE! YAY! but they did say that they would be testing the system before repair and if it is a chargeable problem ie not 3 red lights they will contact me for my card details. So, sorry Mr Vapor but you maybe screwed.

subject: Red Lights
author: FrozenVapor
body: Ummm... it's nice that they cover the 3 red lights, but I've been getting the 2 red lights the last few days and apparently only the 3 lights are covered by this warranty. Am I screwed? :-|
